description: This file implements a tool for editing files with support for fast apply edits via external APIs like Morph, KiloCode, and OpenRouter. It includes functions for cost calculation, parameter validation, applying fast apply edits, and configuration management, along with tracking contributions and user approval workflows.

classes.name: MorphApplyResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a fast apply edit attempt, including success status, resulting code, error message, and usage metrics.

methods.name: calculateFastApplyCost
methods.description: Calculates the cost of a fast apply edit based on input/output tokens and model pricing.

methods.name: validateParams
methods.description: Validates required parameters for the editFileTool function.

methods.name: editFileTool
methods.description: Main function to handle file editing with support for fast apply, user approval, diff viewing, and contribution tracking.

methods.name: applyFastApplyEdit
methods.description: Performs a fast apply edit by calling external APIs like Morph, handling response, and extracting the merged code.

methods.name: getFastApplyConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the current fast apply configuration based on the provider state, including API keys, URLs, and model info.

methods.name: isFastApplyAvailable
methods.description: Checks if fast apply is available based on current configuration.

methods.name: getFastApplyModelType
methods.description: Determines whether the current fast apply model is Morph or Relace based on configuration.
